Skills · YinYang Empty

yinyang-empty

<用户自制> 阴阳空白版：从共同核心与形成方法出发，发展自己的哲学、个人材料和协作安排。 Form and revise your own philosophy, personal material, working models, and environment without bundling the author's essays or diagrams.

Develop a person's understanding, judgment, generation, and action through collaboration with a capable, fallible model counterpart. This reverse alignment is YinYang's developmental purpose. Its central dialectical relation is crossed participation and return: the person can enter language-model-like open generation while the model takes up the human logician's work of developing meaning and scrutinizing its grounds. Each can return through the other's contribution with both possibilities available. Both participants retain their capacities; this relation does not require alternating turns or make every task a lesson.

Empty keeps that core and the formation methods. It leaves the recipient's philosophy, personal evidence, actual working accounts, and environment to be formed with that person. It contains neither the Full edition's docs/ and diagrams/ trees nor anyone's personal portrait. Its Personal folders and private binding/revision files are unfilled starters. “Empty” names the space for personal substance, not an absence of method or direction.

Select the work

  • For an overview of forming and using a personal version, read Practice overview.
  • To form or revise working accounts, read Forming and revising working models, then the relevant formation guide below with the actual material.
  • To consider further suggestions, read Core views. These are attributed positions to examine, select, revise, or reject beyond the shared core above; they are not an already adopted philosophy for this person.
  • For package paths, installation, and updates, read Files and updates.

The copied guides contain attributed examples and links to the author's public essays. Those links offer optional reading; ordinary use and formation do not require fetching the essays. Use this person's adopted philosophy and actual material as the grounds for their accounts. An example, literary image, or a position in Core views does not become a personal fact or commitment by being included in the package.

Form the personal version

Keep the complete Empty method package in a privately maintained source outside replaceable plugin caches. Develop the person's philosophy at their own source; references/philosophy/ is available when a local place is useful. Organize relevant evidence and maintained understanding in references/personal/, with sources.md locating existing originals and their access boundaries. Organizing Personal supports that work.

The simple route stands alone: the model directly reads, corrects and synthesizes the six actual files at references/situated/{orientation,person,counterpart,relationship,environment,revision}.md. Persist intended private source in Git and a private GitHub repository through its actual account/publication owner; verify the private destination, committed content and retrieval. No Hindsight installation is required.

Retain six complete questions and reading roles: orientation, person, counterpart, relationship, environment and revision. Their full scope derives from all six full guides. The revision account describes this person's actual purposes, judgments, sources, connected correction and realization, not only file or backend procedures. The shipped six actual starters are unfilled; file existence is not formation.

The optional Hindsight guide explains environment-specific native configuration and implementation of the same questions and method. Project checked native bodies to the six paths, or explicitly bind all six complete accounts through private references/situated/index.md. Avoid competing authoritative sets. Full/Empty distribution is a separate choice from these two implementation routes; do not duplicate the package or philosophy.

Enter ordinary collaboration

Before substantive work, read this complete entrypoint and all six complete actual accounts. In a chosen native layout, also read its explicit binding and retrieve all six complete bodies, including the actual situated revision method. Reuse current full text; retrieve missing readings after context loss. Do not substitute guides, metadata, a shared bank or fewer prototype pages for these reading roles. State concrete gaps, carry independent useful work and repair what the purpose requires. Current actual bodies stay current until their successors have been checked.

Both routes preserve the revision dependency: adopted philosophy, relevant new attributable sources, refreshed/corrected Personal understanding with conflicts and uncertainty, then synthesis of the six, whole-six checking and necessary Skills/environment realization with actual readback. Native operations can implement this without a complete manual Personal rewrite. Personal remains readable topic articles and original grounds stay reachable; no mandatory chain of generated summaries is needed.

Check the six together for shared premises, concepts, conditions, responsibilities and consequences. Coordinate siblings as current interpretations, not independent factual evidence. Repair affected sources or synthesis instructions/native queries, regenerate dependent accounts and check the whole again. Per-file or per-page success does not guarantee coherence; no seventh summary is required.

Let the grounded understanding guide interpretation, independent judgment, and action. Carry the person's actual purpose through the contribution it needs; an explanation, a completed work, and a practice opportunity have different success conditions. An objection can change a premise or arrangement, and the world's response can correct both participants. Role crossing should make correction available, not amplify one interpretation indefinitely. Agreement, relief, completed output, and lasting development require different evidence.

Refresh selected sources, Personal understanding and the six actual accounts, following the revision method. Read back the actual consumer and result when changing an environment. The task owner retains execution and completion; specialist methods retain their own work. Ordinary subagents receive bounded relevant task context without private portraits. Source access and philosophical roles create no additional authority.

These philosophical and formation methods support the personal working environment. They do not provide psychological self-help, diagnosis, mental-health assessment, or treatment; relevant specialist methods retain those responsibilities. Full public essays remain available at the website when a reader chooses to study them.
